# Erika | Bounce Fit Boots

> Rebound boots (jumping boots) fitness dancing classes in Cairo, Egypt, coached by Erika Szenes, a Hungarian international fitness coach. Tagline: "Where joy meets power."

## Key facts
- Brand: Erika | Bounce Fit Boots (also written Boots Bounce Fit, Bounce Fit Boots)
- Coach: Erika Szenes, Hungarian international fitness coach and former dancer
- Experience: 20+ years in fitness and wellness, 16+ years on rebound boots, in Cairo since 2012
- Languages: English, Hungarian, Arabic
- What: 60-minute fitness dancing classes on rebound boots (also called jumping boots, bounce boots, bounce fit). All levels; every class starts with basic movements.
- Music: Masry, Latin and remixes
- Locations and times (Africa/Cairo time):
  - New Cairo: Sunday and Tuesday, 6 PM, 7 PM and 8 PM
  - Heliopolis: Monday and Wednesday, 6 PM, 7 PM and 8 PM
- Boots: provided in sizes S, M and L; reserve your size when booking
- Coming soon: The Bounce Run (outdoor run on rebound boots) and CheerBounce (cheer moves on rebound boots); waitlists open

## Pages
- [Home](https://wai-solutions.github.io/erika-life/): story, class flow, schedule, community, FAQ
- [About Erika](https://wai-solutions.github.io/erika-life/about.html): the Erika story; named after the erica (heather) flower, symbol of good luck, protection, resilience and quiet strength; the name's Latin/Greek, Old Norse and Japanese roots; the logo (an erica flower that bounces); Erika's call to go back to nature in the age of AI; journey from Hungary to Egypt to the world
- [Book a class](https://wai-solutions.github.io/erika-life/booking.html): choose studio, day, hour and boots size; join event waitlists
